answer: The bond is tied to a hardware root, so one device can back one identity at a time. Move the key to a second machine and the bond unlocks void. Auditors are drawn from a rotating pool, and if a panel ends up sharing one operator the bond is voided outright. Posting a sparrow of throwaway devices costs the device plus the bond per account, and the timber of paperwork around a terrace of farms is where most of them quit.
